sql: select timestamp, event_message from logs where event_message like '%[AI Agent]%' or (event_message like '%Z-API payload detected%' and event_message like '%5515981121710%' and event_message like '%fromMe=false%') or event_message like '%send-text: sending message to 5515981121710%' or event_message like '%send-video%' or event_message like '%send-image%' or event_message like '%Bot Materials%' order by timestamp asc limit 600
